annotations.title: Compare a Commander case or display with its decks

description: Read exact Commander case or deck display membership and USD market-price references for an equivalent set of individual decks. A product named Case or Display, such as Bloomburrow Commander Deck Display, qualifies. Use it to compare that package with its required child quantities. Resolve the numeric case product with spellbook_sealed_product_search first. Returns source-linked recipe counts, case and component price clocks, existing gross EV snapshots, reference arithmetic, missingFields and limitations. A reference difference excludes shipping, stock, taxes and fees; unavailable delivered offers remain explicit. Use spellbook_box_ev_rankings for existing EV alternatives.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

tcgProductId.description: Exact numeric TCGplayer Commander case or deck display product ID from sealed product search. A single deck and a complete deck set can have different IDs.

name: spellbook_commander_case_comparison
